Small companies · French VAT · in French

VAT tracker

For small French companies under the standard VAT schemes (réel normal, monthly or quarterly, or réel simplifié) that track VAT in a spreadsheet. Sales, purchases, expenses and fixed assets entered net or gross, VAT calculated to the cent with any gap flagged; output and input VAT per period and per rate, VAT due or credit carried forward; a configurable filing and payment schedule with "filed" and "paid" ticks; checks before filing (wrong VAT amount, unusual rate, entry added after filing, missed deadline, forgotten credit). CSV export and import. A tracking aid, not tax advice: it does not file anything.
